intro: Follow the colored edges one by one to see what each cloth layer contributes to the pattern. The technique study uses an invented design.
alt: Microsoft looks into a display case at a multilayer cloth study with red, yellow, pink and dark channels.

variants.name: mola
variants.look: Colored channels appear where upper cloth layers are cut back. Fine stitches hold down their edges.
variants.history: Guna makers, particularly women in present-day Panama and Colombia, developed mola panels for garments. Reverse appliqué often works alongside other stitches and applied details.
variants.when: Study a documented panel when you want to understand how a design can be built by revealing material from underneath.
variants.why: A single cut reveals a new color and makes the depth of the fabric itself part of the image.

source.label: Smithsonian National Museum of the American Indian
